description: Calving (front retreat) + frontal-melt boundary traces on the van der Veen CFBC shelf state (same state as runs/ssa.json but on a SQUARE grid -- see the domain note). (a) Rate-based calving: EigenCalving (strain-rate invariants + rate, exact-velocity run and a manufactured divergent-velocity run exercising the nonzero branch), vonMisesCalving (clean pointwise rate from the von Mises criterion sigma_tilde = sqrt(3) B e_s^(1/n)), HayhurstCalving (pointwise threshold-on-flotation rate with the floating-shelf adjustment). (b) In-place mask removal: CalvingAtThickness (thickness-threshold) and FloatKill, with mask/thickness in/out per cell. (c) Frontal melt: the FrontalMeltPhysics pointwise kernels (undercutting + ISMIP6) over (h, q_sg, TF) grids, and the Constant frontal-melt model on the shelf (default config -> zero on a fully floating shelf; with frontal_melt.include_floating_ice = yes -> a melt-rate map and the front-cell retreat rate).

regenerate.note: Run from the repo root (the -dumps_dir path is relative to the working directory). Override the grid with -Mx/-My (must be equal) and the output with -dumps_dir. The driver creates the thickness-calving input file stage1/dumps/calving/thickness_threshold_input.nc (a minimal NetCDF-3 file without the thickness_calving_threshold variable, so the constant config threshold is used).

domain.note: SQUARE grid required: EigenCalving, vonMisesCalving and HayhurstCalving reject non-square cells (|dx-dy|/min(dx,dy) <= 1e-2 in init()), so the SSA run's 61x3 flow-line grid cannot be used. The shelf state is uniform in y, so the exact solution H(x), u(x) = V0 H0 / H(x), v = 0 is unchanged. The shelf occupies columns i in [0, 59] (60 ice columns, same as the 61-column SSA run) and 5 ocean columns beyond the calving front (i = 60..64) so the +-2-cell calving-rate sampling stays in the interior.

setup.flow_law: isothermal_glen with B = 1.9e8 Pa s^(1/n) (set via flow_law.isothermal_Glen.ice_softness = B^-n), n = 3

van_der_Veen.note: C is the 'typical constant ice parameter'; corresponds to the isothermal Glen B = 1.9e8. The exact along-flow strain rate is du/dx = C H^3.

calving_config_overrides.calving.eigen_calving.K: 3e16 m s (set from the config default 0.0 so the formula branch is exercised; ~1e9 m a, within the cited range 3e16..1e19 m s)
calving_config_overrides.calving.thickness_calving.threshold: 300 m (set from the config default 50 m so the front, H = 188.8 m, is calved)
calving_config_overrides.calving.thickness_calving.file: stage1/dumps/calving/thickness_threshold_input.nc (created by the driver; no thickness_calving_threshold variable, so init() falls back to the constant threshold)

frontal_melt_config.frontal_melt.include_floating_ice: no for the default run (all-zero melt on the fully floating shelf); toggled to yes for the second Constant-model run
frontal_melt_config.frontal_melt.routing.parameter_a: 3e-4, parameter_b 0.15, power_alpha 0.39, power_beta 1.18 (defaults; the FrontalMeltPhysics kernel parameters)

setup.velocity_for_calving: the actual SSA solution from one SSAFD solve on this geometry (avg error 0.0619% vs the exact solution)
setup.divergent_velocity: manufactured field v = 0.05 u cos(2 pi y / L), L = 500 km, used only for the eigen-calving nonzero-branch exercise

dump_files.meta.txt: pism revision, config file, grid, front column, command line
dump_files.parameters.csv: calving.*, frontal_melt.*, constants.*, grid.* config keys
dump_files.inputs.nc: geometry (usurf, thk, topg, mask, sea_level), SSA velocity (u,v), enthalpy, and the three calving-rate outputs
dump_files.eigen_calving.csv: per cell: (i, j, x, y, H, mask, u, v, eigen1, eigen2, du_dx_analytic = C H^3, front-cell sampling eigen1_avg/eigen2_avg/N_avg, rate). Exact velocity: eigen2 = 0 exactly -> rate 0 everywhere
dump_files.eigen_calving_divergent.csv: same for the manufactured divergent velocity; nonzero rate at 32 of the 65 front cells where eigen2 > 0
dump_files.vonmises_calving.csv: per cell eigen rates + rate; at the 65 front cells also the reconstructed |v|_avg, hardness_avg, e_s, sigma_tilde; rate = |v|_avg sigma_tilde / sigma_max
dump_files.hayhurst_calving.csv: per cell (H, mask, sea_level, bed, water_depth, omega, sigma_0, threshold, rate); rate propagated to ice-free cells next to ice as the mean of icy neighbors (intended)
dump_files.calving_at_thickness.csv: per cell H_in/H_out, mask_in/mask_out, threshold, removed
dump_files.float_kill.csv: per cell H_in/H_out, mask_in/mask_out, h_f = (sea_level - bed) rho_w / rho_i, floating, removed
dump_files.frontal_melt_undercutting.csv: (h, q_sg, TF) -> q_m m/day, with the nonnegativity clamps
dump_files.frontal_melt_ismip6.csv: (h, q_sg, TF) -> q_m m/day, without the clamps
dump_files.frontal_melt_constant.csv: Constant model melt + retreat rates for both include_floating_ice settings; front-cell H_threshold/H_submerged
dump_files.thickness_threshold_input.nc: minimal NetCDF-3 input file the CalvingAtThickness constructor requires (no threshold variable -> constant config threshold)

checks.strain_rate_analytic: eigen1 matches du/dx = C H^3 on interior floating cells (i in [8, 56]): max relative error 0.00149777 (0.15%, FD truncation + SSA discretization); max |eigen2| = 7.916e-25 (eigen2 = A - q = 0 exactly for the 1-D shelf, v = 0).
